title: Outsmarting the Chameleon: Counterfactual Decoupling for Tactical OOD Shifts in Live Streaming Risk Assessment

problem.claim: Live streaming faces increasingly sophisticated risks, including tactical out-of-distribution shifts in which malicious actors preserve underlying objectives while redesigning narrative packaging to evade detection.

gap.claim: Existing OOD generalization paradigms have assumptions that are difficult to satisfy under tightly coupled intent–tactic evolution and ill-defined raw-level counterfactuals.

narrative_sequence.summary: Live streaming is a major medium for social interaction and digital commerce but is increasingly affected by sophisticated risks.
Malicious actors maintain stable objectives while continually changing narrative packaging, creating tactical OOD shifts.
Existing OOD generalization approaches struggle because their assumptions do not readily fit coupled intent–tactic evolution and ill-defined raw-level counterfactuals.
